dataset: Stage B — Tatoeba EN-DE validation (500 sentences)
normalisation: punctuation spaced out to match BPE tokenizer output
comparability_note: Our BLEU is measured on Tatoeba (short, simple sentences). Paper BLEU is on WMT14 newstest2014 (news domain). Scores are not directly comparable. A fair comparison requires WMT14 training and newstest2014 evaluation.
